title: Coroner orders inquest
article: An inquest into the death of Mladen Cujko will be held April 25- 30 in the Western Communities courthouse.

Cujko, a 33-year-old known drug user from Burnaby, died Aug. 31 from a cardiac arrest during a struggle with a West Shore RCMP officer on the Trans-Canada Highway. He was pronounced dead on arrival at Victoria General Hospital.
Cujko had been running in and out of traffic, screaming for help. He was on his way to hospital when he fought his way out of the police car.
During the autopsy, police found cocaine cut with caffeine in a plastic bag in his underwear.

Coroner Lisa Lapointe said the inquest is mandatory because Cujko died in police custody. It will try to establish why and by what means Cujko died. Use of police force will be one of many factors that will be examined, she said.
